## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 3.12.2.Edge Protection

- Edge protection is to meet the following requirements:
- ·Be strong and rigid enough to prevent people from falling and be able to withstand other loads likely to be placed on them
- Be fixed to a structure or part of a structure capable of supporting them
- Guards to be a minimum of 950mm above any edge from which personnel are liable to fall
- Intermediate guard rails are to be positioned to ensure the any gap does not exceed 470mm
- Toeboards aretobefitted andextend150mmabovetheplatform
- Barriers other than guard rails and toe boards can be used so long as they are at least 950mm high secure and provide an equivalent standard of protection against falls and materials rolling or being kicked from edges.

## 3.12.3. Mobile Tower Scaffold

- Tower scaffolds are to be erected, altered and dismantled by a competent person in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
- Tower scaffolds are tobe erected onfirm level groundwith thewheelsorfeet properly supported.
- The height tobaseratio of tower scaffolds is tobein accordancewith manufacturersinstructions however general requirements should be that the outriggers shall be usedwhere the ratioof height to smallest base dimension is greater than 3:1.
- Safe access is to beprovided to and from thework platform.Climbing up the end frames isnot safe except where:
- The frame has an appropriate designed built-in ladder
- A purpose madeladder can be attached safely on the inside
- Tower scaffolds are to be fitted with guard rails, a fully boarded platform and toe boards. Tower scaffolds are not to be moved whilst personnel or materials remain on the platform.Tower scaffolds are to be inspected by a competent person:
- Beforefirstuse
- Aftersubstantial alteration
- After any event that may have affected its stahility
- If it remains in place longer than 7 days it should be inspccted every 7 days
- A scafftag is to be fitted to the tower scaffold showing the date of the last inspection. Unsafc mobile scaffolds arc to show a red scafftag. Safe Scaffolds should show a green scafftag.
